blocks.title: Revenue and profit
blocks.text: Revenue is all the money a business earns from selling goods or services. Profit is what is left after subtracting all costs, such as rent, salaries and the cost of goods.

A Lahore shop sells 100 school bags at Rs 500 each: revenue = 100 x 500 = Rs 50,000. With total costs of Rs 30,000, profit = 50,000 - 30,000 = Rs 20,000. Many small Pakistani businesses are in the informal sector and do not always report revenue and profit, which makes the economy hard to measure.
